belief: After death we become spirits floating forever.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that after death we become spirits floating forever, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Cartoons and movies showing people as ghosts on clouds. Funeral sayings that focus only on the soul. Never learning about the resurrection of the body. Ideas borrowed from other religions or philosophies. Finding a bodiless eternity hard to look forward to.
teaches: Believers who die are with the Lord, but that is not the final chapter. Scripture promises a bodily resurrection. After He rose, Jesus said, “Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.” He is the firstfruits of all who will rise. Our bodies will be raised imperishable, glorious, and powerful, and God will make a new heaven and a new earth where He will dwell with His people. Our future is not floating; it is resurrection life.
self_statements: We’ll just be spirits in the sky.
I won’t have a body anymore.
Heaven will be vague and shadowy.
The physical world doesn’t matter forever.
I can’t imagine what forever will be like.
errors: Accepting cultural pictures of the afterlife instead of Scripture’s.
Overlooking the promise of resurrection and a new earth.
Settling for a fuzzy picture that makes eternity hard to love.
Assuming eternity will be empty or unreal.
questions: What did Jesus show His disciples after He rose?
What does it mean that Christ is the firstfruits?
How does 1 Corinthians 15 describe the resurrection body?
What will Jesus do with our lowly bodies?
What does God promise to make new?
Where did my picture of floating spirits come from?
How does the hope of resurrection change how I see eternity?
truth: After death, believers are with the Lord, and one day we will be raised with real, glorious bodies like Jesus’ resurrection body. God will make a new heaven and a new earth and dwell with His people. My future is not floating forever; it is resurrection life with Christ.
hw_questions: What did Jesus show after He rose?
How is the resurrection body described?
What will Jesus do with my body?

hw_truths: Jesus rose with a real body, and so will I.
Christ is the firstfruits of those who will rise.
My body will be raised imperishable and glorious.
God will make a new heaven and a new earth.
God will dwell with His people.
log: Each day, write one thing I look forward to about resurrection life.
name_example: But Sarah’s citizenship is in heaven, and she eagerly awaits a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ, who will transform her lowly body to be like His glorious body.

tracker: One resurrection hope I thought about
prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You that You rose from the dead with a real body and that I will be raised too. Help me reject the idea that after death we become spirits floating forever. Fill me with hope for resurrection life and for the new heaven and new earth where You will dwell with us. In Your name, Amen.
